Worlds

The game itself

Gameplay

What will you do first?

Learn professions, make useful gear and trade with other players.

Quick access · your 10 slots
More buttons · drag up, or tap to add
Drag a button to a slot to place it there. Drop it on another button to swap. Drag it back down to remove it. On a phone: tap a button to move it.
Settings
Switch Character
Back to the character list. You stay signed in, and nothing on the server is touched.
Sign Out
Signs out of the account on this device. Your characters wait on the server.
Delete Account
Removes your account, every character, all items and gold, and your chat messages. Reported or moderated messages are kept without your name for up to 12 months. This cannot be undone.
Terms of Use
What you agreed to when you started playing. Also covers trading, chat and account closures.
Privacy Policy
What we store about you, why, for how long, and your rights.
Email updates
A mail when there’s a big update — a few times a year. Unsubscribe any time.
Handle —
Your account name. Friends find you by it.
Password
Change the password for this account.
Core Sounds
The melody the core plays while you hold.
Music
The generative background track. Starts on your first hold.
Sound Effects
Chat Notifications
Bubble when someone whispers you, chime for guild announcements — only when you are not looking at that tab.
Music Volume
Background Track
Save power
These settings keep your phone or computer cooler and your battery fuller. They are all on to start with. Nothing in the game itself changes — turn one off if you want the extra eye candy.
Stop looping glows
Glows and pulses that loop forever are switched off. Text, pictures and everything you need stay exactly the same.
Still globe
The globe on the map does not spin by itself and is only drawn while you drag it — and never while the map is off screen.
Lower frame rate
The game draws about 30 times a second instead of up to 120, and updates its panels a little less often.
Rounded corners
Windows, cards and buttons get soft rounded corners instead of straight ones.
Quick access buttons
Pick which buttons sit in the Quick access box and in what order. Drag them around, or tap to move.
Nixie’s tips
One-time tips the first time something new happens. The tour itself can be restarted here.
After travel
What the map does when you arrive in a zone: zoom into the zone, stay on the region map, or open the zone window with quests, encounters and expeditions.
Double-click a zone
Double-click a charted zone on the map to travel there at once, with no window. Then the map can zoom into the zone or stay on the region map.
